survey: A cartoon palm tree on a sand dune with a magenta backdrop. The camera sits low and slightly above the sand: we see a little of the sand's top and the horizon line crosses about two thirds of the way down the card. The trunk is a tapered cylinder made of stacked ring segments. It rises out of the sand at the lower left and leans right as it climbs. The ring lines are roughly at right angles to the trunk's axis (red ~168° against the blue ~71° sides) and keep the same spacing and tilt all the way up, so they follow the cylinder. The trunk's base sinks into a small mound of sand, and that edge sits level with the ground. Two coconuts hang in front of the top of the trunk, overlapping it, so they read as nearer than the trunk. About eight fronds spread out from the crown: the upper ones arch up and droop outward, showing their top surfaces on the drooping parts, while the lower ones hang down and show their sides and undersides, which fits a crown above eye level. The rocks and the trunk's shadow lie flat on the sand at the same angle as the ground. The tool marks show no edges that should be parallel but aren't, and no ellipses that contradict each other.
